features.name: Copilot Test Toolkit
features.description: An AL extension that allows partners to test Copilot features efficiently, including managing test suites, data sets, and data-driven testing. It can be installed in a sandbox environment and is available in the BC apps repo. Supports creating test suites with input data sets, executing test procedures, logging results, and downloading test outputs for external evaluation.
features.status_evidence_quote: in this release, we are introducing the Copilot Test Toolkit in preview that allows you to test Copilot features
caveats: Must be installed in sandbox environment
Mocking is used in demos which prevents actual token consumption
Not all features can be easily evaluated within Business Central
Azure AI Studio evaluation requires separate billing

features.name: Sales Line Suggestion Feature
features.description: An AI feature that allows users to input text and generates suggested sales lines to add to orders. Tested using the toolkit with data-driven testing approach.
caveats: Test suite ran 28 tests with 27 passing and 1 failing
Failures require manual fixes before rerunning

features.name: Data-Driven Testing for Copilot
features.description: A testing approach where the same test runs repeatedly against different input values, enabling better coverage of language model sensitivity and response variations.

features.name: Accuracy Testing for Copilot
features.description: Unit-level tests for atomic parts of LLM round trips, including absolute tests and grounding tests to verify explicit values and correct data are returned.

features.name: Quality Testing for Copilot
features.description: End-to-end and integration tests to handle user interaction scenarios, red teaming, harms testing, bias and toxicity detection in Copilot features.

features.name: AI Test Context Code Unit
features.description: A code unit used in test procedures to retrieve input values from data sets such as question, answer, context, ground truth, and expected data. Also supports setting test output for external evaluation.
caveats: Different features may require different sets of input fields

features.name: External Evaluation with Azure AI Studio
features.description: Integration with Azure AI Studio for evaluating AI features that are difficult to test in Business Central, such as marketing text quality and safety. Supports built-in evaluators and custom evaluator creation.
caveats: Different evaluation metrics require different input sets

features.name: Marketing Text Feature
features.description: An AI feature that generates marketing text for items based on input facts, format, and tone settings. Requires external evaluation through Azure AI Studio due to difficulty in programmatic evaluation.
caveats: Test output needs to be configured with context and question for external evaluation

features.name: Multi-Turn Testing Support
features.description: Support for testing conversational scenarios with multiple inputs and outputs per test case. Enables testing of features where previous conversation context matters, such as chat scenarios.
caveats: Requires sequential API calls through next_turn

features.name: Test Suite Import and Export
features.description: Ability to import and export test suite configurations as XML files, enabling easier sharing and version control of test definitions.

features.name: API Pages for Test Toolkit
features.description: API pages available in the test toolkit that allow programmatic access without needing to use the UI interface, part of the roadmap toward full test automation.
